svg.title: Chaos Engineering
svg.desc: Chaos Engineering. Inject failures on purpose to prove the system degrades the way you expect. Step 1, Steady state, hypothesis: Steady state from outside: 99.9% success. Hypothesis: losing 1 of 3 instances keeps it above 99.5%. Step 2, Inject a small failure: One instance is terminated in production: the load balancer routes around it and success holds. Step 3, Find a weakness, stop: Payments slowed by 2 s: with no timeout, calls pile up; below 99% the guardrail stops the run. Step 4, Fix, rerun, make routine: With a timeout and fallback the rerun passes. It then runs weekly, and the blast radius grows.

g.text: Steady state from outside: 99.9% success. Hypothesis: losing 1 of 3 instances keeps it above 99.5%.
One instance is terminated in production: the load balancer routes around it and success holds.
Payments slowed by 2 s: with no timeout, calls pile up; below 99% the guardrail stops the run.
With a timeout and fallback the rerun passes. It then runs weekly, and the blast radius grows.
the on-call team is told first
next: lose a zone, not an instance
if it fires: stop the experiment
